# Sortly

> Sortly is an all-in-one inventory management platform with barcode/QR scanning, real-time tracking, and integrations for small businesses and enterprises.

Sortly provides cloud-based inventory software designed to simplify asset tracking, supply management, and inventory control across multiple locations and industries. The platform combines mobile scanning capabilities with team collaboration features and integrations with popular business tools like QuickBooks, Amazon Business, and Microsoft Teams.

## Key Topics

- Barcode scanning
- QR code tracking
- Inventory management
- Asset tracking
- Real-time tracking
- Low-stock alerts
- Mobile app
- Team collaboration
- Multi-location tracking
- Equipment tracking
- Integrations
- Reporting & analytics
- SKU management
- Supply tracking
- Small business solutions

- [Barcode Inventory Software | Sortly](https://www.sortly.com/barcode-inventory-system): Sortly barcode and QR code generation/scanning from smartphone

- [Inventory Alerts | Sortly](https://www.sortly.com/features/alerts): Sortly low stock and date-based alerts for inventory control optimization
